
```{julia}
using CurrentSheetTestParticle
using DrWatson

begin
    θ = 45
    v = 8
    β = 90
    d = @dict(θ, β, v)
    diffeq = (; dtmax=1e-3)
    init_kwargs = (; Nw=8, Nϕ=128)
    sols, (wϕs, B) = solve_params(RDProblemParams(; diffeq, init_kwargs, d...))
end;
```


```{julia}
using CurrentSheetTestParticle: field_lines_distance

dists = map(sols) do sol
    field_lines_distance(sol, B)
end
```

```{julia}
using CairoMakie
using AlgebraOfGraphics
using DataFrames, DataFramesMeta
df = DataFrame(dists)
@info "Statistics" maximum(df.dR_perp_min) maximum(df.dR_perp_asym)
@chain df begin
    @transform! :wϕ = wϕs
    @rtransform! begin
        :w0 = :wϕ[1]
        :ϕ0 = :wϕ[2]
    end
end

w0 = :w0 => x -> string(round(x, digits=2))

f = Figure()
spec = data(df) * AlgebraOfGraphics.density() * (mapping(:dR_perp_asym) * mapping(; color=w0))

draw!(f[1, 1:3], spec)
draw!(f[2:4, 1:3], data(df) * mapping(:ϕ0; layout=w0) * (mapping(:dR_perp_asym) + mapping(:dR_perp_min)) * visual(Lines))
f

```
